_comment: OPTIONAL. Copy to .mcp.json at the repo root ONLY if you want a market-data MCP server. Nothing here is required: the system works with built-in WebSearch/WebFetch. Never commit API keys; reference environment variables. Review any third-party MCP server's code, permissions and pricing before enabling it. If you add one, grant it ONLY to research agents by adding `mcpServers:` to their frontmatter, and never to an agent that could place orders or move money. Read-only data servers only.
